verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents automatic user provisioning: changes made to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to a connected third-party app. That covers part of the app-by-app lifecycle propagation through the product's own configuration, but there is no evidence of a no-code workflow builder triggered by identity events. Apps Script is low-code, developer-built automation and dynamic groups are an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: no-code workflow builder, explicit triggers for hire, role change and departure, multi-step cross-app orchestration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, identity events trigger automation — no-code workflows on hire, role change, and departure handle the app-by-app choreography for me

citations.quote: Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
